name: Abraham John Architects
description:
Abraham John ARCHITECTS is a multidisciplinary architecture, interior design, landscaping and urban planning firm founded in 1967.

Abraham John & Alan Abraham are the Joint Principal Architects of Abraham John Architects.

Abraham John Architects’ design approach is to re-connect architecture with nature, make optimum use of space, natural materials, lighting & landscape to reinvent and transform living environments and urban spaces.

The firm works at multiple scales and with various organizations right from private clients to corporates & NGOs allowing itself to experiment and diversify its work.

featured_reviews.name: Supriya VB
featured_reviews.review_text:
Back in 2019, we got our home designed by Soar Designs. It was a challenging brief — combining my husband’s taste with mine felt nearly impossible — but Sonal truly made it work like magic. She took the time to understand our vision and brought it to life with so much thought and creativity.

Our home is fully Alexa-enabled, and she made it happen at a time when smart homes were still a new concept in the market.

Sonal has an incredible eye for minimalist design, blending beauty with functionality. Every corner of our home feels intentional, elegant, and truly us. Couldn’t have asked for a better experience or a more beautiful space to call home!

owner_posts.post_text:
Experience Luxury Villas Like You're Already There

A single photograph captures a moment. A 360° Virtual Tour captures the entire experience.

At 360 Space, we create premium Villa 360° Virtual Tours that allow buyers, investors, architects, and guests to explore every room, outdoor space, and design detail from any device.

Whether you're marketing a luxury villa, holiday home, farmhouse, or premium residential project, an immersive virtual walkthrough builds trust, increases engagement, and helps qualified buyers make faster decisions.

Our Villa 360° Shoot Includes:

✅ High-resolution 360° photography
✅ Interactive virtual walkthroughs
✅ Drone 360° panoramic views
✅ Branded navigation and hotspots
✅ Mobile & VR compatible tours
✅ Google Maps & website integration

Perfect for:
• Luxury Real Estate Developers
• Independent Villa Owners
• Architects & Interior Designers
• Vacation Rental & Hospitality Brands

Give your audience the freedom to explore every corner before they visit.

📍 Serving luxury properties across India.

360 Space Presents: Experience Properties from Sunrise to Night 🌅🌃

Have you ever wondered how your property looks at different times of the day? With 360 Space’s Day/Night 360° Property Views, explore interiors, exteriors, and landscapes under dynamic lighting conditions. Witness how sunlight highlights rooms in the morning and how ambient lights transform the property at night.

This immersive experience lets buyers and investors visualize lifestyle, ambiance, and design aesthetics, helping them make confident decisions. Perfect for high-rise apartments, villas, and commercial properties, it’s an engaging tool for virtual tours, and marketing campaigns.

🎬 See your property transform from day to night in 360°!

360 Space Presents: The Future Built on Today’s Landscape 🌍✨

Ever imagined how your upcoming project will look on the actual site before construction begins? With 360 Space’s Drone + 3D Superimposition, we overlay detailed CGI building models on real drone footage, creating an ultra-realistic preview of your future property in its natural environment.

From luxury towers to township masterplans, this technique combines precision aerial captures with photorealistic 3D visualization, allowing clients and investors to experience the project’s scale, surroundings, and design accuracy before a single brick is laid.

🎬 See your future project rise before your eyes – right on the real site!

360 Space Presents: Discover the Story Behind Every Property 📸✨

Ever wondered how a property truly comes to life? With 360 Space’s Image & Video Gallery, every corner, facade, and amenity is captured in stunning detail. From high-resolution photos to cinematic walkthrough videos, buyers can explore interiors, exteriors, and landscapes without visiting the site.

Our galleries are perfect for residential, commercial, and luxury projects, allowing clients to see textures, materials, and design details up close. Integrate the gallery, social media, or websites to engage buyers, investors, and stakeholders, giving them a digital preview that sparks curiosity and interest.

🎬 Explore the gallery and see the story your property has to tell!

360 Space Presents: Drone Construction Updates – Watch Progress from Above 🚁✨

Keep buyers, investors, and stakeholders updated with 360 Space’s drone construction update videos! Capture the property’s progress at every stage with aerial shots, multi-height perspectives, and smooth motion tracking, giving a complete view of construction development.

These drone updates create a visual timeline of the project, highlighting how designs are taking shape, exterior finishes are applied, and landscapes are developed. Perfect for marketing campaigns, and client communications, these videos build trust and excitement, keeping your audience engaged throughout the construction journey.

360 Space Presents: Turn Images into Stunning Videos with AI 🤖✨

Ever imagined a single image coming alive as a video? With 360 Space’s AI-based Image-to-Video service, static property renders transform into cinematic walkthroughs, dynamic day/night views, and interactive experiences. Buyers can see interiors, exteriors, and landscapes move and evolve before visiting the site.

Perfect for residential, luxury, or commercial projects, this AI-powered technology helps marketers create engaging social media content, and property presentations with minimal effort while maximizing impact. Witness your property from a single image to a fully immersive video experience.

🎬 Discover how AI brings your property images to life like never before!

360 Space Presents: Explore Every Level – Multi Height 360° Views 🏢✨

Have you ever wondered how a multi-floor property truly feels? With 360 Space’s multi-height 360° views, you can explore every floor, terrace, and balcony digitally. See the property from different levels, understanding spatial flow, design continuity, and views from every angle.

This immersive experience gives buyers a unique perspective, helping them visualize interiors, exteriors, and surroundings before stepping foot on the property. Perfect for high-rise apartments, villas, and commercial developments, it’s a must-have for websites, and marketing campaigns.

🎬 Discover how every level of your property comes alive in 360°!

360 Space Presents: OC Received Project Announcement 🎉🏢

Celebrate milestones with 360 Space’s OC received CGI videos! Showcase your completed project in stunning 3D visuals, highlighting exterior facades, interiors, landscaping, and amenities. Perfect for announcing occupancy certificates, project completions, and handovers to clients and investors.

Viewers can experience the property digitally with immersive walkthroughs and detailed visuals, creating excitement and building trust. These videos are ideal for social media updates, investor communications, and marketing collateral, keeping your audience engaged and informed.

🎬 Watch the OC received video and celebrate your project’s success!

360 Space Presents: Discover Every Corner – Interactive Floor Plan Views 📐✨

Ever wondered how your future home truly flows? With 360 Space’s interactive floor plan views, you can explore every room, corridor, and corner before construction begins. Our 3D floor plan visualizations turn static layouts into immersive digital experiences, letting buyers see space, proportions, and connectivity like never before.

Explore hidden details like balcony access, room orientation, and sunlight angles, giving potential buyers a real feel for the property. Perfect for residential, luxury, and commercial projects, these floor plans can be embedded in websites, social media, and sales presentations, making your listings more engaging and interactive.

🎬 See how your floorplan comes to life and explore spaces before anyone steps inside!

360 Space Presents: Interactive Realty Sales App 📱✨

Take property marketing to the next level with 360 Space’s interactive realty sales app! Buyers can explore properties, layouts, 3D walkthroughs, floorplans, and virtual tours from their mobile or desktop devices, making property discovery seamless and engaging.

The app integrates CGI videos, 360 virtual tours, AR/VR experiences, and multimedia property hotspots, allowing clients to navigate properties at their own pace. Perfect for marketing campaigns, sales presentations, and remote client engagement, this interactive platform enhances buyer experience and accelerates decision-making.

🎬 Explore the interactive sales app and experience properties like never before!

featured_reviews.name: Ritika Wadekar
featured_reviews.review_text: 360 Space handled everything for us - drone shoots of the site, realistic architectural 3D rendering of interiors, 360 virtual tours and a smooth video animation walkthrough. They work like a proper 3D visualization studio, not just a rendering vendor. Having one team manage everything kept the output consistent and the process much smoother. The experience made our renovation process so much easier and their quality is genuinely reliable.

featured_reviews.name: Manasi Patkar
featured_reviews.review_text: I had no idea how my home would look after interiors until 360 Space made a complete 3D interior walkthrough and 360 interactive virtual tour for us. The renders looked like real photos and the tour was immersive which gave complete idea about the layout. I understand why they’re considered among the top 10 3D visualization companies in India - the quality is on another level.

featured_reviews.name: sailee kadam
featured_reviews.review_text: I was looking to build my dream home and wanted to visualize the designs before moving forward. The 3D renderings and VR tours I received were beyond my expectations. I could walk through each room virtually and get a real sense of the space. This service really helped me make confident decisions in the design process. I’d recommend it to anyone building or buying a home.

featured_reviews.name: Kejal bafna
featured_reviews.review_text: We got a 360 virtual tour and interior renderings of the flat done and trust me, my parents understood the floor plan layout immediately. They usually can’t read floor plans, but this 360 tour made everything simple. It also helped us decide wall colours. Seeing it virtually is so much better than just choosing from a catalogue. Good work by 360 space team.

featured_reviews.name: parag kothari
featured_reviews.review_text: We partnered with 360Space to create a virtual tour and CGI walkthrough for our project launch, and the response has been fantastic. Buyers were able to experience the sample flat remotely and understand the space without ever visiting the site. The quality of animation and camera movement was at par with international real estate films. This has now become a key part of our marketing toolkit.

featured_reviews.name: Angarika Dalvi
featured_reviews.review_text: We got our 3 BHK apartment interiors visualized through a 3d virtual tour by 360 Space which is based in Mumbai and it honestly made us emotional. Seeing our dream home come alive in front of us before the actual work started was such a special experience.

featured_reviews.name: Krisha Kothari
featured_reviews.review_text: We were in need of interior renderings for an upcoming office space redesign. The team delivered a fantastic set of images that allowed us to clearly present the new layout and design to our client. Every detail was captured, from the lighting to the furniture placement. Will definitely be using them for future projects.

featured_reviews.name: Priyal Ranka
featured_reviews.review_text: Our virtual interior tour made by 360Space was absolutely beautiful. The 3D walkthrough of our apartment helped us visualize every detail with precision — from materials to décor. The team’s creativity and photorealistic rendering quality made it feel like a real shoot. For virtual interior tours, 3D walkthroughs, and home visualization in Mumbai, 360Space is a fantastic company to work with.
